metadata.title: Garbage Collection (Computer Science) — Detailed Connected Knowledge Graph
metadata.description: A machine-readable graph of automatic memory management, tracing and reference-counting algorithms, generational/incremental/concurrent/real-time collectors, compiler/runtime contracts, languages, diagnostics, security, and research.
metadata.source_basis: User-provided Wikipedia article on Garbage collection (computer science), with explanatory context added to connect algorithms and implementations.
notes: This graph distinguishes programming-language heap garbage collection from SSD flash-storage garbage collection.
Collector availability and behavior vary by language runtime, vendor, platform, and version; historical collectors are identified as such.
GC generally does not guarantee prompt cleanup of sockets, file descriptors, database handles, or secure memory zeroization.
The supplied article's GC-versus-explicit-memory performance study is represented with its oracle-generated-baseline caveat.

entities.name: Garbage collection
entities.description: Automatic memory management that reclaims allocated objects no longer considered live.

entities.name: Automatic memory management
entities.description: Memory reclamation managed by runtime/compiler rather than explicit deallocation at every use site.

entities.name: Manual memory management
entities.description: Programmer-directed allocation and deallocation with explicit lifetime responsibility.

entities.name: Runtime system

entities.name: Garbage object

entities.name: Memory reclamation

entities.name: Mutator

entities.name: Garbage collector

entities.name: GC cycle

entities.name: Tracing garbage collection
entities.description: Finds live objects by tracing references from roots.

entities.name: Reference counting

entities.name: Mark-and-sweep

entities.name: Mark-and-compact

entities.name: Copying garbage collection

entities.name: Stop-and-copy collector

entities.name: Semispace collector

entities.name: Sweep phase

entities.name: Compaction phase

entities.name: Write barrier

entities.name: Read barrier

entities.name: Card table
